function: Joint DRL control of BS active beamforming, STARS transmission/reflection coefficients and controller power, together with edge caching replacement, to minimize network power (p. 12, 15).
system: BS with M=4 antennas, single-antenna users, passive STARS (energy splitting, independent or coupled T&R phases) with N=16 elements; narrowband, 1 MHz, carrier frequency not stated (p. 6, 8, 24).
method: Deep reinforcement learning: frequency-aware TD3 (FA-TD3) for independent phases, cooperative TD3-DQN for coupled phases; trained by episodes in a simulated environment (p. 15, 19).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician channels (factor 3 dB, path-loss exponent 2), users randomly placed within 3 m of the STARS, Zipf requests; no standard model or dataset (p. 23, 24).
test_conditions: Reward and power curves versus training episode in one simulated setting; sweeps over Zipf factor, cache size, learning rate; no separate test or unseen scenario stated (p. 25-27).
baselines: Learned: conventional TD3, TD3 with optimal DQN. System variants: Caching-at-RIS, STARS-aided and RIS-aided edge caching, no-cache STARS/RIS; no non-learned control method (p. 24-27).
metrics: Average network power consumption (W/s), reward, cache hit rate (p. 25-27).
complexity: none; only a qualitative remark that cooperative TD3-DQN increases complexity (p. 26).
q1_support: p. 23: "All channels are follow the Rician channel model" - a custom simulator; no 3GPP model, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 26: "Fig. 7 illustrates the power consumption of all schemes for various relative cache size." - a sweep only; the paper never says a trained model is tested on a configuration not used in training.
q3_support: p. 26: "the gap between FA-TD3 and traditional TD3 with same learning rate gradually increase" - a learned baseline (TD3) exists, but no non-learned method (random or fixed phases, MMSE, optimization) is compared.
q4_support: p. 26: "though the complexity of the algorithm is increased" - qualitative only; no order of complexity, operations, parameter count or runtime is reported.
q5_support: p. 24: "The system parameters is shown in Table I." - custom simulator with a parameter table; no code or data link, no public dataset.
notes: The PDF is the arXiv v1 preprint (2308.00562v1) and prints no DOI; its title is 'Caching-at-STARS: the Next Generation Edge Caching' and nothing indicates another paper. Included under the above_phy rule: the DRL agent learns BS beamforming and STARS coefficients jointly with caching replacement (p. 13, 15), the caching part being above the physical layer; the main metric is network power. Reviewer to confirm this judgement. Area 3 by function.
